resources.string: Send bank and MoMo SMS to Flipper
This phone forwards transaction messages from BK, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, Equity and I&M to your Flipper Cash Book and bank feed. Other messages never leave the phone.
In Flipper, open Settings → SMS Bridge → Pair a phone, then scan the code it shows.
Also send messages already on this phone from the last:
That is not a Flipper SMS Bridge code.
Working. Bank SMS will appear in Flipper within a minute.
This phone was unpaired in Flipper. Pair it again.
Stop sending SMS to Flipper? Messages not yet sent are deleted from this phone.
SMS permission is off, so nothing can be forwarded.
Android may block SMS access for apps installed outside the Play Store. If the switch is greyed out: open App info → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
